snippet.title: Ore Factory Squad - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play alone or with friends, buy properties, dig deep for valuable resources, complete contracts, upgrade and automate production lines and grow your factory from zero to industry!

Wishlist now on Steam:
